decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Sample panels of brickwork showing areas of poulticed and cleaned areas using Doff system shall be provided on site and approved by the local Planning Authority before works are commenced.

Condition : 4 - 4. Full Details of where the Ledger will be located and stored while works are being undertaken and date of reinstatement to be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works.
Condition : 5 - Full details and sample panels of the proposed finish to all grained joinery be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works.
description: Repairs and minor alterations to toll office building (listed building)
